name: ranierimachado/news-aggregator
description: A multi-perspective news pipeline for Drupal 11. RSS ingestion, article-level AI bias and topic classification against a versioned rubric, story clustering into neutral events, consensus synthesis, semantic search and cost monitoring. Everything site-specific is config.

suggest.drupal/gemini_provider: Google Gemini provider for drupal/ai. Optional; not usable from DigitalOcean IPs with AI Studio keys.
suggest.drupal/ai_provider_ollama: Run classify/relevance operations on a local Ollama model via ai.settings operation_models.
suggest.drupal/ai_vdb_provider_milvus: Milvus/Zilliz vector backend used only as a local comparison stack; MariaDB native vector is the wired default.
suggest.drupal/search_api_solr_dense_vector: Solr 9.6+ dense-vector fields for the hybrid /explore engine (with drupal/search_api_solr and drupal/facets). Optional; the Solr code is inert without it.
